messages:
emma_support: Heads-up — multiple customers in eu-west1 are seeing intermittent 504s on /v1/generate since 08:50 UTC. SDK logs show retry loops and duplicated billing. sample request-id: rwd-req-0f7a2c

sre_matt: Can you paste an SDK log and one full request-id? Also which model and approximate prompt size?

emma_support: Request-id `rwd-req-0f7a2c` (customer AcmeRetail). Model: ra-large-v1, prompt ~3k tokens. SDK log snippet:
```
[2026-02-14T08:51:12Z] WARN http: 504 Gateway Timeout
[2026-02-14T08:51:12Z] INFO retry: attempt=3 backoff=500ms
[2026-02-14T08:51:12Z] ERROR stream reset: HTTP2_RST_STREAM(0x2)
```

dev_jordan: Noticed auth token rotation job ran at 08:49 UTC for eu auth cluster. Possible token TTL mismatch — edge clients may be sending stale tokens and edge proxy is waiting on auth lookup which times out.

sre_matt: Repro steps requested. Emma — can you run a curl against eu edge with the customer's headers and paste response headers? Example curl:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"ra-large-v1\",\"input\":\"hi\"}' https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

emma_support: Pasted below — response shows 504 and `x-rwd-edge-request: rwd-req-0f7a2c` header:
```
< HTTP/2 504
< date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 08:51:13 GMT
< x-rwd-edge-request: rwd-req-0f7a2c
< x-rwd-auth-lookup: timeout
```

sre_matt: Thanks. That `x-rwd-auth-lookup: timeout` is key. I'm opening an incident and adding auth infra. (incident INC-2026-455)

auth_ops_liz: We saw a short DB lock on token store at 08:49 which delayed TTL refreshes; by the time edge asked, auth service returned 500 and edge timed out -> 504 to client. We're rolling a patch to not block lookup on DB writes.

sre_matt: Mitigation: 1) Route affected traffic to fallback `ra-small-v1` for 15m, 2) increase auth lookup timeout to 3s at edge, 3) ask support to advise customers to increase SDK backoff.

emma_support: Notified customer A and B. Customer asked about double billing from SDK retries — billing_liz can you advise?

billing_liz: We'll run billing dedupe for rwd-req-0f7a2c..rwd-req-0f7a2f and issue credits for duplicated attempts. Also adding note to customer communication.

dev_jordan: Patch merged to auth service, rolling out now. Watch for reduction in `x-rwd-auth-lookup: timeout` headers.

sre_matt: Status page updated — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-455 :white_check_mark:

support-bot: @channel Incident INC-2026-455 created, priority P2, owners: sre_matt, auth_ops_liz, dev_jordan

emma_support: Thanks all. Repro steps + curl + logs posted. I'll close the customer loop once credits applied and edge timeout fixed.

billing_liz: Credits queued, should show within 48 hours.

sre_matt: Postmortem scheduled for Mon. Follow-ups: increase auth cache redundancy and apply graceful degradation so edge returns 503 quickly instead of timing out.

emma_support: (customer updated) they've confirmed decreased errors after 08:58 UTC. Closing thread in 1h unless regressions.
